prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a reusable illustration style reference for MaiPace's "Phố giấy" visual direction. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use the hand-painted neighborhood art in the upper portion of the supplied desktop concept. Ignore and do not reproduce the UI, typography, logo, sidebar, controls, cards or layout.
Create ONE beautiful standalone editorial illustration on a clean warm near-white paper background, landscape 4:3. It is a contemporary Japanese neighborhood in a charming hand-drawn paper illustration style. Style: fine expressive charcoal-pencil outlines, flattened cut-paper shapes, soft watercolor/gouache pigment, subtle natural paper grain inside painted areas, restrained warm gray and sand buildings, muted sage plants, a few small vermilion accents, generous cream negative space, gentle morning light without dramatic shadows. Sophisticated and friendly, youthful adult learners, small editorial character proportions, natural faces, not chibi or anime mascots, not photorealistic, not 3D.
Composition: a small ordinary wooden storefront with a blank pale awning at one side, a potted plant and parked bicycle, and two friendly young adults politely meeting near the center. Adult A: short tousled dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, charcoal trousers, simple dark backpack. Adult B: chin-length straight dark bob, cream cardigan over muted brick-red shirt, charcoal skirt, carrying a small closed plain notebook. Both fully visible, facing each other with a slight polite bow, hands natural, no exaggerated expressions. Keep their eyes and faces visible, not deep bows. Simplified architecture recedes in the background. The little scene feels welcoming and teaches no textual claim. Leave space around the whole composition; nothing clipped at canvas edges.
Hard constraints: NO text, letters, numerals, Japanese writing, speech bubbles, signs with writing, logo, watermark, UI, borders, labels, swatches or multiple panels. No pagoda, temple, Mount Fuji or giant cherry-blossom canopy; daily neighborhood life, not tourism. Shop signs and notebook covers are entirely blank. No fake transparent checkerboard. Background opaque near-white with quiet paper texture, not dark beige. This picture establishes the brushwork, character design, architectural simplification and palette for later banner/lesson assets. Render a highly finished professional reusable reference.
